findings.summary: The turn from perceiving to relating was deleted, and with it the tenet’s place in the structure.

evidence.baseline: With the fourth tenet the work turns from perceiving to relating ... It is the hinge on which the first three tenets open into all that follows, for one who is not in some measure turned on by life will not have the charge to relate to it generously.
evidence.shipped: Wholesome Eroticism names a felt enthusiasm for being alive.

findings.authorizedBy: Compression, and catalog 4.23 applied to the turn announcement.
findings.diagnosis: Part VI promised three tiers where each presupposes the one before. This is the only tenet that shows the joint, and the hinge sentence is the argument for why vitality precedes relation. Without both, the tier structure is announced in the introduction and never demonstrated.

findings.summary: The account of what the tenet is not lost its positive half.

evidence.baseline: It is not sexuality but the channeling of life-force: a pure relationship with the animating forces of existence, in which desire may be expressed as it arises, without agenda and without grasping.
evidence.shipped: It is broader than sexuality and does not authorize uninvited expression of desire.

evidence.baseline: a pure relationship with the animating forces of existence, in which desire may be expressed as it arises, without agenda and without grasping
evidence.shipped: Its question is whether desire can remain warm and generative without turning another being into its instrument. It does not authorize uninvited expression. Consent is not a brake placed on vitality. It is part of the form through which vitality becomes trustworthy.

improvements.note: The baseline bounds desire only from the desirer's side, agenda and grasping, and says nothing about the other person. The kept paragraph supplies the missing party and recasts consent as constitutive rather than restrictive, which is stronger than a prohibition. Promoted from a quiet kept to a credited finding.
